{"command":"cat > /tmp/create_control_memo.py <<'PY'
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT, WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_SECTION
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path('/work/workspace/03_Governance_and_Approval/Travelers_Superseded_Draft_Workbook_Control_Memo.docx')

def set_cell_shading(cell, fill):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = tcPr.find(qn('w:shd'))
    if shd is None:
        shd = OxmlElement('w:shd')
        tcPr.append(shd)
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill)

def set_cell_margins(cell, top=90, start=110, bottom=90, end=110):
    tc = cell._tc
    tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcMar = tcPr.first_child_found_in('w:tcMar')
    if tcMar is None:
        tcMar = OxmlElement('w:tcMar')
        tcPr.append(tcMar)
    for m, v in [('top', top), ('start', start), ('bottom', bottom), ('end', end)]:
        node = tcMar.find(qn(f'w:{m}'))
        if node is None:
            node = OxmlElement(f'w:{m}')
            tcMar.append(node)
        node.set(qn('w:w'), str(v))
        node.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')

def set_cell_border(cell, **kwargs):
    tc = cell._tc
    tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcBorders = tcPr.first_child_found_in('w:tcBorders')
    if tcBorders is None:
        tcBorders = OxmlElement('w:tcBorders')
        tcPr.append(tcBorders)
    for edge in ('top', 'left', 'bottom', 'right', 'insideH', 'insideV'):
        if edge in kwargs:
            edge_data = kwargs[edge]
            tag = 'start' if edge == 'left' else 'end' if edge == 'right' else edge
            tag = f'w:{tag}'
            element = tcBorders.find(qn(tag))
            if element is None:
                element = OxmlElement(tag)
                tcBorders.append(element)
            for key, val in edge_data.items():
                element.set(qn(f'w:{key}'), str(val))

def set_repeat_table_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    tblHeader = OxmlElement('w:tblHeader')
    tblHeader.set(qn('w:val'), 'true')
    trPr.append(tblHeader)

def set_keep_with_next(paragraph, keep=True):
    pPr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    node = pPr.find(qn('w:keepNext'))
    if keep and node is None:
        node = OxmlElement('w:keepNext')
        pPr.append(node)
    elif not keep and node is not None:
        pPr.remove(node)

def set_keep_lines(paragraph):
    pPr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    if pPr.find(qn('w:keepLines')) is None:
        pPr.append(OxmlElement('w:keepLines'))

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    paragraph.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
    run = paragraph.add_run('Page ')
    run.font.size = Pt(8)
    fldChar1 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar1.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), 'begin')
    instrText = OxmlElement('w:instrText'); instrText.set(qn('xml:space'), 'preserve'); instrText.text = ' PAGE '
    fldChar2 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), 'end')
    run._r.append(fldChar1); run._r.append(instrText); run._r.append(fldChar2)
    run2 = paragraph.add_run(' of ')
    run2.font.size = Pt(8)
    fldChar1 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar1.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), 'begin')
    instrText = OxmlElement('w:instrText'); instrText.set(qn('xml:space'), 'preserve'); instrText.text = ' NUMPAGES '
    fldChar2 = OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), 'end')
    run2._r.append(fldChar1); run2._r.append(instrText); run2._r.append(fldChar2)

def set_col_widths(table, widths):
    for row in table.rows:
        for idx, width in enumerate(widths):
            row.cells[idx].width = width

def add_meta_table(doc, data):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=2)
    table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    table.autofit = False
    set_col_widths(table, [Inches(1.75), Inches(5.9)])
    border = {'val':'single','sz':'4','space':'0','color':'C7CDD4'}
    for label, value in data:
        row = table.add_row()
        row.cells[0].text = label
        row.cells[1].text = value
        for i, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
            set_cell_margins(cell)
            set_cell_border(cell, top=border, bottom=border, left=border, right=border)
            cell.vertical_alignment = WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
            for p in cell.paragraphs:
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
                p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
                for r in p.runs:
                    r.font.name = 'Aptos'; r.font.size = Pt(9)
            if i == 0:
                set_cell_shading(cell, 'E9EDF2')
                for r in cell.paragraphs[0].runs:
                    r.bold = True; r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(31, 47, 64)
    return table

def add_body(doc, text, bold_prefix=None, bullet=False):
    style = 'List Bullet' if bullet else None
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(5)
    p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.06
    if bold_prefix and text.startswith(bold_prefix):
        r = p.add_run(bold_prefix); r.bold = True
        p.add_run(text[len(bold_prefix):])
    else:
        p.add_run(text)
    set_keep_lines(p)
    return p

doc = Document()
sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.top_margin = Inches(0.55)
sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.55)
sec.left_margin = Inches(0.72)
sec.right_margin = Inches(0.72)
sec.header_distance = Inches(0.25)
sec.footer_distance = Inches(0.25)

styles = doc.styles
styles['Normal'].font.name = 'Aptos'
styles['Normal'].font.size = Pt(9.4)
styles['Normal'].paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
for style_name, size, color in [('Title', 20, '84202A'), ('Heading 1', 12.5, '84202A'), ('Heading 2', 10.5, '1F2F40')]:
    st = styles[style_name]
    st.font.name = 'Aptos Display' if style_name in ('Title','Heading 1') else 'Aptos'
    st.font.size = Pt(size)
    st.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    st.font.bold = True
    st.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(8 if style_name == 'Heading 1' else 5)
    st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)

# Header
header = sec.header
hp = header.paragraphs[0]
hp.text = 'THE TRAVELERS COMPANIES, INC.   |   FINANCIAL CONTROLS'
hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
for r in hp.runs:
    r.font.name = 'Aptos'; r.font.size = Pt(8); r.bold = True; r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(92, 103, 112)
# underline header
pPr = hp._p.get_or_add_pPr(); pbdr = OxmlElement('w:pBdr'); bottom = OxmlElement('w:bottom')
bottom.set(qn('w:val'),'single'); bottom.set(qn('w:sz'),'8'); bottom.set(qn('w:space'),'4'); bottom.set(qn('w:color'),'84202A')
pbdr.append(bottom); pPr.append(pbdr)

# Footer
footer = sec.footer
fp = footer.paragraphs[0]
fp.text = 'Confidential — Internal Finance Governance  •  AMC-2025-0917  •  '
fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
for r in fp.runs:
    r.font.name = 'Aptos'; r.font.size = Pt(8); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(92, 103, 112)
add_page_number(fp)

# Top label
p = doc.add_paragraph()
p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
r = p.add_run('CONTROL MEMORANDUM')
r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(9); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(132, 32, 42)

p = doc.add_paragraph(style='Title')
p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
p.add_run('Superseded Draft Workbook Evidence Disposition')
set_keep_with_next(p)

p = doc.add_paragraph()
p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(10)
r = p.add_run('ServiceNow GRC case AMC-2025-0917  |  29 September 2025')
r.italic = True; r.font.size = Pt(9.5); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(65, 75, 85)

# Conclusion callout
call = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
call.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
cell = call.cell(0,0)
set_cell_shading(cell, 'F7EEEE')
set_cell_margins(cell, top=130, start=150, bottom=130, end=150)
red = {'val':'single','sz':'10','space':'0','color':'84202A'}
set_cell_border(cell, left=red, top={'val':'nil'}, right={'val':'nil'}, bottom={'val':'nil'})
p = cell.paragraphs[0]
p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
r = p.add_run('CONTROL CONCLUSION  '); r.bold = True; r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(132,32,42); r.font.size = Pt(9)
r = p.add_run('Accept the recorded disposition—not the workbook as valid approval evidence. ')
r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(9.2)
p.add_run('The orphaned, superseded draft remains an audit follow-up item. Final authority is the Steering Committee decision of 26 September 2025, effective with 2025-Q4 management reporting. FY2024 statutory and U.S. GAAP results remain unchanged.')

h = doc.add_paragraph('Evidence identification and condition', style='Heading 1'); set_keep_with_next(h)
add_meta_table(doc, [
    ('GRC evidence record', 'EVD-25-0715-008 — Workbook Test (in scope)'),
    ('Inventory source workbook', 'WB-ALLOC-FY2025-DRAFT-v1.xlsx'),
    ('Attachment condition', 'No longer attached; historical record is Orphaned.'),
    ('Checksum', 'MISSING — no checksum value is recorded, and the unavailable attachment cannot be re-hashed or verified.'),
    ('Disposition', 'Superseded draft. Retain the inventory record for audit follow-up on the attachment/retention exception; do not use it as operative model support or final approval evidence.'),
    ('Evidence certification', 'ATT-20250929-001 — Evidence Certification, Accepted; Michael T. Callahan; 29 September 2025.')
])

h = doc.add_paragraph('Approval determination', style='Heading 1'); set_keep_with_next(h)
p = add_body(doc, 'The approval trail distinguishes a draft evidence review from the governance decision that established the methodology:')

ap = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=4)
ap.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
ap.autofit = False
headers = ['Action', 'Body / date', 'Final?', 'Control conclusion']
for i, txt in enumerate(headers):
    c = ap.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = txt; set_cell_shading(c, '84202A'); set_cell_margins(c, top=80, bottom=80)
    for r in c.paragraphs[0].runs:
        r.bold = True; r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255,255,255); r.font.size = Pt(8.3)
set_repeat_table_header(ap.rows[0])
rows = [
    ('APP-25-0909-07', 'Early Evidence Review Panel\n9 Sep 2025', 'No\n(final_action_flag = 0)', 'Draft evidence review only. Its own comment states that it does not establish the final methodology decision.'),
    ('APP-25-0926-08', 'Travelers Expense Allocation Steering Committee\n26 Sep 2025', 'Yes\n(final_action_flag = 1)', 'Authoritative approval that established the methodology for FY2025 management reporting beginning with 2025-Q4.')
]
for ri, rowdata in enumerate(rows):
    row = ap.add_row()
    for i, txt in enumerate(rowdata):
        c = row.cells[i]; c.text = txt; set_cell_margins(c, top=75, bottom=75)
        if ri % 2 == 0: set_cell_shading(c, 'F3F5F7')
        for p in c.paragraphs:
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
            for r in p.runs: r.font.name='Aptos'; r.font.size=Pt(8.1)
set_col_widths(ap, [Inches(1.25), Inches(2.05), Inches(1.30), Inches(3.0)])
gray = {'val':'single','sz':'4','space':'0','color':'C7CDD4'}
for row in ap.rows:
    for c in row.cells: set_cell_border(c, top=gray,bottom=gray,left=gray,right=gray)

add_body(doc, 'Why the draft cannot approve the methodology. The source is a superseded draft; its attachment and checksum are missing; and the related 9 September evidence-panel action is explicitly non-final. Preserve the inventory entry to make the retention exception and non-reliance conclusion visible. Do not treat it as the controlled workbook, execution evidence, or a substitute for the final committee action.', bold_prefix='Why the draft cannot approve the methodology. ')

h = doc.add_paragraph('Activation and FY2024 no-restatement conclusion', style='Heading 1'); set_keep_with_next(h)
add_body(doc, 'Activation period. The approved methodology applies to FY2025 management reporting beginning with 2025-Q4; it is not a retrospective FY2024 accounting policy change.', bold_prefix='Activation period. ')
add_body(doc, 'FY2024 treatment. The FY2024 analysis is a controlled management-reporting comparison and model baseline. It redistributes a fixed $1,286.597 million pool among operating segments without changing recognized consolidated expense. Legacy and activity-based allocations each total $1,286.597 million, so the consolidated impact is $0.000 million and the reported consolidated combined ratio remains 92.5%. Accordingly, there is no basis to reopen or restate FY2024 statutory statements or U.S. GAAP results.', bold_prefix='FY2024 treatment. ')

h = doc.add_paragraph('Record handling and source basis', style='Heading 1'); set_keep_with_next(h)
add_body(doc, 'This memo adds certification context only. It does not revise the historical evidence record, approval actions, or the two existing governance documents.', bullet=True)
add_body(doc, 'Governance documents reviewed unchanged: Travelers_FY2024_ABC_Management_Approval_Memo.docx and Travelers_Expense_Allocation_Methodology_and_Controls.docx.', bullet=True)
add_body(doc, 'ServiceNow records reconciled: case AMC-2025-0917; evidence EVD-25-0715-008; actions APP-25-0909-07 and APP-25-0926-08; certification ATT-20250929-001.', bullet=True)

# Compact sign-off band
sp = doc.add_paragraph()
sp.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(5); sp.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
for text, bold in [('Prepared for: ', True), ('Financial Controls evidence file', False), ('   |   ', False), ('Certification attester: ', True), ('Michael T. Callahan, Financial Controls Director', False)]:
    r=sp.add_run(text); r.bold=bold; r.font.size=Pt(8.5); r.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(65,75,85)

# document properties
props = doc.core_properties
props.title = 'Superseded Draft Workbook Evidence Disposition'
props.subject = 'ServiceNow GRC case AMC-2025-0917 control memo'
props.author = 'Financial Controls'
props.keywords = 'Travelers, ABC, ServiceNow GRC, evidence certification, superseded workbook, no restatement'
props.comments = 'Created as a new control memo; existing governance documents unchanged.'

# Prevent row splits where possible
for table in doc.tables:
    for row in table.rows:
        trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
        cantSplit = OxmlElement('w:cantSplit')
        trPr.append(cantSplit)

OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
doc.save(OUT)
print(OUT)
PY
